description: Run XtraBackup, Mydumper, and Binlog backups against MySQL hosts.

fail_when.message: 'mydumper_dump_triggers' must not be set when backup_type is not 'M'.
'mydumper_desync_pxc' must not be set when backup_type is not 'M'.
'mydumper_use_numa' must not be set when backup_type is not 'M'.
'xtrabackup_kill_queries' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_verify' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_prepare' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_desync_pxc' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_rsync' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_replica_info' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_stop_replica' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_lock_ddl' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'xtrabackup_quiet' must not be set when backup_type is not 'X'.
'encrypt' must not be set when 'encryption_format' does not include GPG.
'post_run_encrypt' must not be set when 'encryption_format' does not include GPG.
A GPG 'encryption_format' requires 'encrypt' or 'post_run_encrypt' to select when the backup is encrypted.
'encrypt' encrypts the backup in place as part of an upload, so it requires at least one upload provider. Use 'post_run_encrypt' (Mydumper and XtraBackup only) to encrypt on the host instead.
A Binlog backup encrypts only as part of an upload, so 'post_run_encrypt' requires at least one upload provider.
A Binlog backup encrypts only as part of an upload, so an AES-256 format requires at least one upload provider.

fields.description: Database service to back up; PMM Extensions resolves its host and port from inventory
fields.label: Database Host
fields.name: service_id

fields.description: Backup method for this task; it selects the tool that runs and which sections below apply
fields.label: Backup Type
fields.name: backup_type

fields.description: Name for this server in backup paths and reports (defaults to the service address)
fields.label: Server Alias
fields.name: alias

fields.description: Root directory on the database host where backups are written. XtraBackup adds a subdirectory per run, Mydumper one per day that a second run the same day writes into, and Binlog keeps its files directly under the server's own directory.
fields.label: Backup directory
fields.name: backup_dir

fields.description: How many daily backups to keep before the oldest are deleted
fields.label: Daily purge (days)
fields.name: mydumper_daily_purge

fields.description: How many Monday-dated backups to keep before the oldest are deleted. A weekly backup is an ordinary daily run that landed on a Monday.
fields.label: Weekly purge (weeks)
fields.name: mydumper_weekly_purge

fields.description: Include table triggers in the dump
fields.label: Dump triggers
fields.name: mydumper_dump_triggers

fields.description: Desync the node from the PXC cluster while the backup runs, so flow control does not stall the cluster. Ignored on a non-PXC node.
fields.label: Desync PXC node
fields.name: mydumper_desync_pxc

fields.description: Interleave mydumper's memory across every NUMA node instead of letting it fill one
fields.label: Use NUMA
fields.name: mydumper_use_numa

fields.description: Extra arguments for the mydumper command. They are placed ahead of the arguments PMM Extensions sets, so one that clashes is overridden.
fields.label: Extra args
fields.name: mydumper_extra_args

fields.description: Mydumper log verbosity, from 0 (silent) to 3 (info)
fields.label: Verbose level
fields.name: mydumper_verbose

fields.description: How many backup copies to keep on the host before the oldest are deleted
fields.label: Number of backup copies
fields.name: xtrabackup_copies

fields.description: Kill queries that block the backup's lock instead of waiting for them
fields.label: Kill blocking queries
fields.name: xtrabackup_kill_queries

fields.description: How long a blocking query may run before it is killed (seconds)
fields.label: Kill-queries timeout (s)
fields.name: xtrabackup_kill_queries_timeout

fields.description: Which blocking queries may be killed: SELECTs only, or any statement
fields.label: Kill query type
fields.name: xtrabackup_kill_query_type

fields.description: Verify the InnoDB pages of the finished backup. Skipped automatically when compression is on, when AES-256 encryption is applied during the backup (which is every backup binary except mariadb-backup), and on an incremental run under the 'less space' method.
fields.label: Verify after backup
fields.name: xtrabackup_verify

fields.description: Apply the redo log so the backup is ready to restore without a prepare step. Compression is dropped and the upload skipped whenever this is set, including when an incremental method turns the prepare itself off.
fields.label: Prepare for restore
fields.name: xtrabackup_prepare

fields.description: Memory the prepare step may use, as a size such as 2G
fields.label: Prepare memory
fields.name: xtrabackup_prepare_memory

fields.description: Desync the node from the PXC cluster while the backup runs, so flow control does not stall the cluster. Ignored on a non-PXC node.
fields.label: Desync PXC node
fields.name: xtrabackup_desync_pxc

fields.description: Copy non-InnoDB files with rsync to shorten the lock at the end of the backup. Unrelated to the Rsync upload provider.
fields.label: Use rsync
fields.name: xtrabackup_rsync

fields.description: Record the source's replication coordinates in the backup, so a restore can resume replication from it
fields.label: Include replica info
fields.name: xtrabackup_replica_info

fields.description: Defaults file passed to the backup binary, when it differs from the one used for connections
fields.label: XtraBackup defaults file
fields.name: xtrabackup_defaults_file

fields.description: Extra arguments appended to the backup binary's command
fields.label: Extra args
fields.name: xtrabackup_extra_args

fields.description: How incrementals are stored. 'Less space' chains each incremental to the one before it, which saves disk but has to be merged in order to restore. 'Fast restore' merges each incremental into the base, so the latest backup is always ready to restore.
fields.label: Incremental method
fields.name: xtrabackup_incremental_method

fields.description: 'daily', 'weekly', or an ISO weekday number (1-7, Monday-Sunday) controlling when the full backup runs. Applies to the 'less_space' incremental method only.
fields.label: Incremental cycle
fields.name: xtrabackup_incremental_cycle

fields.description: Unused: PMM Extensions always runs XtraBackup on the database host itself, so the backup is never streamed to another host.
fields.label: Local SSH destination
fields.name: xtrabackup_local_ssh_destination

fields.description: Pause the replica SQL thread while the data is copied, so the replication coordinates recorded in the backup match it. Needed to record them at all on a multi-threaded replica with GTID off.
fields.label: Safe replica backup
fields.name: xtrabackup_stop_replica

fields.description: Block DDL for the duration of the backup, so a schema change cannot corrupt it
fields.label: Lock DDL
fields.name: xtrabackup_lock_ddl

fields.description: Drop the per-file copy lines from the backup log, leaving progress and errors
fields.label: Quiet log (drop per-file copy lines)
fields.name: xtrabackup_quiet

fields.description: Which backup binary to run; pick the one matching the server's fork and version
fields.label: Backup binary
fields.name: xtrabackup_bin_cmd

fields.description: Base name of the server's binary logs, such as mysql-bin, used to find and purge this server's stored files. Required: a Binlog backup fails as soon as it starts without it.
fields.label: Binlog prefix
fields.name: binlog_prefix

fields.description: Delete stored binlogs older than this many days
fields.label: Purge after (days)
fields.name: binlog_purge_days

fields.description: Extra arguments for the binlog streaming command. They are placed ahead of the arguments PMM Extensions sets, so one that clashes is overridden.
fields.label: Extra args
fields.name: binlog_extra_args

fields.description: Command used to compress each completed binlog file, replacing the default
fields.label: Compress command
fields.name: binlog_compress_cmd

fields.description: Path to the mysqlbinlog binary on the host, when it is not the /usr/bin/mysqlbinlog the backup looks for by default
fields.label: Binlog command
fields.name: binlog_cmd

fields.description: Keep this on. The binlog backup streams every server in the task's config, and refuses to start when the option is cleared.
fields.label: Run all binlog backups
fields.name: binlog_run_all

fields.description: Pull binlogs from this host instead of the selected service's address
fields.label: Alternative binlog host
fields.name: binlog_alternative_host

fail_when.message: 'compression_algorithm' must be zstd or lz4 when the backup binary is 'xtrabackup', which is what a blank binary selects.
'compression_algorithm' must be quicklz when the backup binary is 'innobackupex'.
'compression_algorithm' must be quicklz when the backup binary is 'mariadb-backup'.

fields.description: Reuse unchanged files from the previous backup as hard links, so a full backup costs less disk space. Mydumper skips it when the previous backup is encrypted; XtraBackup skips it when post-run encryption is on, when 'Number of backup copies' is 1, and under the 'less_space' incremental method. Binlog backups ignore it.
fields.label: Hardlink full backups
fields.name: hardlink

fields.description: Compress backup data as it is written, using the algorithm selected below. XtraBackup drops compression when 'Prepare backup' or the 'Fast restore' incremental method is on, and a Binlog backup compresses every completed file whatever this is set to.
fields.label: Compress backup data
fields.name: compress

fields.description: Fail before a Mydumper or XtraBackup backup starts when the target filesystem has too little free space. A Binlog backup instead watches free space while it streams and stops the stream when it runs out.
fields.label: Check disk space first
fields.name: check_disk_space

fields.description: Skip the host unless replication is running there, so the backup only runs on an active replica. Mydumper and XtraBackup backups only.
fields.label: Only if running replica
fields.name: only_if_running_replica

fields.description: Skip the host unless MySQL is read-only. Mydumper and XtraBackup backups only.
fields.label: Only if read-only
fields.name: only_if_read_only

fields.description: Meant to kill the queries blocking a FLUSH TABLES WITH READ LOCK during a Mydumper backup. The watchdog is never reached, so this setting changes nothing.
fields.label: FTWRL guardian
fields.name: use_ftwrl_guardian

fields.description: Directory on the database host for this task's log files
fields.label: Logging directory
fields.name: logging_dir

fields.description: MySQL defaults file used for the connections PMM Extensions makes to the server, and for the mydumper or binlog command. The XtraBackup binary reads 'XtraBackup defaults file' instead.
fields.label: MySQL defaults file
fields.name: defaults_file

fields.description: Algorithm used when compression is enabled; the available choices depend on the backup type and, for XtraBackup, on the selected backup binary — xtrabackup takes zstd or lz4; innobackupex takes quicklz; mariadb-backup takes quicklz. A Binlog backup always uses gzip unless 'Binlog compress command' replaces it.
fields.label: Compression algorithm
fields.name: compression_algorithm

forms.description: Pick an 'Encryption format' first; the fields below are that format's parameters.

fields.description: Which encryption this task applies. 'GPG' needs a recipient and a timing below: 'Encrypt backup' encrypts as part of an upload, so it needs an upload provider, while 'Encrypt after backup completes' encrypts on the host for a Mydumper or XtraBackup backup and during the upload — needing a provider too — for a Binlog one. 'AES-256' and 'AES-256 + GPG' need a key file, and for a Binlog backup an upload provider too — AES runs only during upload. 'AES-256 + GPG' selects AES-256 and skips the GPG pass, which the backend cannot apply on top of it.
fields.label: Encryption format
fields.name: encryption_format

fields.description: Path on the database host to the AES-256 key file. Required by the AES-256 formats.

forbidden.message: 'xtrabackup_aes256_keyfile' must not be set when 'encryption_format' does not include AES-256.

fields.label: AES-256 key file path
fields.name: xtrabackup_aes256_keyfile

fields.description: GPG-encrypt the backup as part of an upload, so it requires at least one upload provider. Mydumper and Binlog encrypt the backup where it is written, optionally by way of 'Encrypt using tmpdir'; XtraBackup encrypts a copy and leaves the backup on the host in plain text unless 'Encrypt after backup completes' is set too. Needs a GPG 'Encryption format' and a recipient.
fields.label: Encrypt backup
fields.name: encrypt

fields.description: Encrypt in a temporary directory during the backup. Requires 'Encrypt backup'; mutually exclusive with 'Encrypt after backup completes'.
fields.label: Encrypt using tmpdir
fields.name: encrypt_using_tmpdir

fields.description: GPG-encrypt the finished backup once it completes. Independent of 'Encrypt backup'; mutually exclusive with 'Encrypt using tmpdir'. Needs a GPG 'Encryption format' and a recipient. Mydumper and XtraBackup encrypt on the host and need no upload target; a Binlog backup encrypts only during an upload, so it requires at least one upload provider.
fields.label: Encrypt after backup completes
fields.name: post_run_encrypt

fields.description: GPG recipient/key the backup is encrypted for. Required when either GPG timing is enabled.

forbidden.message: 'encryption_recipient' must not be set when no encryption mode is enabled.

fields.label: Encryption recipient
fields.name: encryption_recipient

requires.message: 'encryption_recipient' is required when 'encrypt' or 'post_run_encrypt' is enabled.

forms.title: Encryption

fields.description: Where the finished backup is copied. Leave empty to keep it on the database host.
fields.label: Upload providers
fields.name: upload

fields.description: Destination S3 bucket, optionally with a path prefix (bucket/path)
fields.label: S3 bucket
fields.name: s3_bucket

fields.description: Storage class applied to uploaded objects (defaults to STANDARD)
fields.label: S3 storage class
fields.name: s3_storage_class

fields.description: Upload even when the bucket allows public access, skipping the block-public-access check
fields.label: Skip S3 safety check
fields.name: skip_s3_safety_check

fields.description: Drop routine progress lines from the upload log, leaving errors
fields.label: Quiet upload logs
fields.name: upload_quiet

fields.description: Extra S3 object options for the upload, as space-separated Key=Value pairs such as ACL=private. Anything without an equals sign is dropped. XtraBackup backups only.
fields.label: AWS S3 upload extra args
fields.name: awscli_s3_upload_extra_args

fields.description: Destination Google Cloud Storage bucket, optionally with a path prefix (bucket/path)
fields.label: Google Cloud Storage bucket
fields.name: gs_bucket

fields.description: Destination path for the rsync upload, as an rsync target
fields.label: Rsync destination path
fields.name: rsync_path

name: mysql_backups
